features.formula_description: Average eligible sales over prior 7 calendar days.
Average eligible sales over prior 30 days.
Average eligible sales over prior 60 days.
Average eligible sales over prior 90 days.
90-day average daily eligible sales multiplied by 365.
Recent 7-day average divided by 30-day average minus one.
30-day average divided by 90-day average minus one.
Standard deviation divided by mean daily eligible sales.
Standard deviation divided by mean daily eligible sales.
Zero-sales days divided by available days.
Peak/trough seasonal contrast with weekday adjustment.
Largest rolling 30-day sales divided by 180-day sales.
Refund amount divided by gross POS sales.
Chargeback amount divided by gross POS sales.
Non-refund reversals divided by gross POS sales.
Deposits divided by eligible POS sales.
Negative balance days divided by observed days.
NSF events in prior 30 days.
Average daily available balance.
Average available balance divided by average daily eligible sales.
Sum of observed monthly fixed obligations.
Expected daily remittance across active short-term obligations.
Count of active short-term sales-based obligations.
True when active short-term financing exceeds configured condition.
Months between incorporation and as-of date.
Months with current processor account.
Weighted source availability, depth, freshness and reconciliation.
Conservative minimum/recent/trailing eligible revenue after quality and confidence haircuts.
Adjusted eligible revenue times industry conversion margin less existing obligations.
Expected eligible sales times requested remittance rate.
Adjusted daily cash flow available divided by total daily fixed/remittance obligations.
Requested funding divided by annualized eligible sales.
